## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is DistroKid?

DistroKid is a service for musicians that puts your music into online stores & streaming services.
Then when people listen to your music, we send you money.

### Why should I use DistroKid?

All your music should be in stores. DistroKid is the only service that lets you upload unlimited
music to stores for one low price and keep 100% of your earnings. Other services make you pay every
time you upload something, or they take a percent of earnings—which is way less fun (and way more
expensive).

### Why is DistroKid better?

DistroKid gets your music into stores in a fraction of the time it takes our competitors to get your
music into stores. We have great customer service, daily stats, a simple interface, and loads of
unique features too.

### Who uses DistroKid?

DistroKid is for solo musicians, artists, bands, DJs, performers, producers, and creators who record
music at home or in the studio. We have services for labels, too.

### How much will it cost me?

Only €23.99 to upload unlimited songs & albums for a year.

### How much of my sales does DistroKid keep?

None.

### Can DistroKid distribute music videos?

Yes! We created DistroVid to get your music videos into Apple Music, Vevo, Tidal, and Boomplay. For
only $8.25/month, you keep 100% of earnings. [Create a free account to receive discounts.][15]

# OBS Studio

Latest Release 32.1.2 - April 21st
[WindowsSupports Windows 10 and Windows 11][8] [macOSSupports macOS 12.0 or newer][9] [Linux][10]

### Select macOS Version

[‹][11] [macOS (Intel)][12] [macOS (Apple Silicon)][13]

Free and open source software for video recording and live streaming.

Download and start streaming quickly and easily on Windows, Mac or Linux.

The OBS Project is made possible thanks to generous contributions from our sponsors and backers.
Learn more about how you can [become a sponsor][14].

# Features

High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple
sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.

Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.

Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take
full control with VST plugin support.

Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust
their properties effortlessly.

Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every
aspect of your broadcast or recording.

Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each
individual Dock to its own window.

OBS supports all your favorite streaming platforms and more.

# Create Professional Productions

Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your
scenes or add your own stinger video files.

Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping
streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.

**Studio Mode** lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your
scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.

Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily
cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

# Collaborative Creativity

OBS Studio is equipped with a powerful API, enabling plugins and scripts to provide further
customization and functionality specific to your needs.

Utilize native plugins for high performance integrations or scripts written with Lua or Python that
interface with existing sources.

Work with developers in the streaming community to get the features you need with endless
possibilities.

Browse or submit your own in the [Resources section][24]

# Features

High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple
sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.

Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.

Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take
full control with VST plugin support.

Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust
their properties effortlessly.

Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every
aspect of your broadcast or recording.

Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each
individual Dock to its own window.

OBS supports all your favorite streaming platforms and more.

# Create Professional Productions

Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your
scenes or add your own stinger video files.

Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping
streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.

**Studio Mode** lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your
scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.

Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily
cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

# Collaborative Creativity

OBS Studio is equipped with a powerful API, enabling plugins and scripts to provide further
customization and functionality specific to your needs.

Utilize native plugins for high performance integrations or scripts written with Lua or Python that
interface with existing sources.

Work with developers in the streaming community to get the features you need with endless
possibilities.

## The Hard Truths About Building AI-Ready Streaming Platforms

Building a streaming business is about the invisible challenges that quietly break platforms, drive
up costs, and frustrate users.

### Scaling Failures

Traffic spikes cause buffering, crashes, and downtime - killing first impressions.

### Content Chaos

Managing libraries, metadata, multi-version content, and multiple languages becomes overwhelming

## Got Questions about Music Distribution? 

### Which streaming platforms do you distribute to?

+

Our digital music distribution service distributes to all the major streaming services: Spotify,
Apple Music, TikTok, YouTube, Deezer, Tidal and 200+ other streaming platforms and stores globally.

### What makes this platform different from other music distribution platforms?

+

We offer free accounts to verified artists who what proven industry traction. This is a strict
application process though our A&R team who review every single applicant.

Why do we do this? 
- We are actively combating streaming fraud in the the music industry
- To ensure that no bad actors get access to our system and take advantage of the tools we offer
- To promote good practices within the music industry
- We want to be proud of all of the music that we distribute and work on at Unchained Music.  

### How do I transfer my catalog from another music distributor?

+

Transferring your catalog from another music distribution service is simple. Before you start,
you’ll need a few key pieces of information, including:
‍

• The UPC and ISRC (these help DSPs identify your existing release);
• Release title and track title(s);Artist(s) name(s);
• The Original Release date and;
• The exact same audio and cover art files from the previous release.

This is the same process for almost every digital music distribution company.

### Are there any fees and do I keep all my royalties?

+

For immediate access to the platform there is a base subscription fee. Artists and labels keep all
there royalties.

For a highly select group of artists we offer free use of our platform, but this at the discretion
of the A&R team. Artists and labels under this core plan also keep 100% of their royalties.

Our unchained partners are all subject to custom deals for our artist and label services.

### Do you offer playlisting or marketing support?

+

Yes - we offer full artists and label services to a select artists. You can find out more [here][68]

On-premises oder Full Managed Hosting in ISO-zertifiziertem deutschen Rechenzentrum

## Unsere Videoplattform­lösungen für jeden Anwendungsfall

**VIMP Enterprise** stellt funktional eine Art YouTube für Unternehmen jeder Größe dar, bietet
jedoch speziell für das interne Umfeld noch mehr eigene Möglichkeiten.

## VIMP vereint alles, was eine Videoplattform benötigt

### Die Enterprise Alternative zu YouTube

VIMP entwickelt seit über 14 Jahren eine Video Hosting Softwarelösung (Video CMS), die in der
Kernfunktionsweise mit YouTube vergleichbar ist – mit VIMP können Sie Ihre eigene Enterprise
Videoplattform erstellen!

### Flexible und skalierbare Lösungen

VIMP ist nach der Installation sofort startklar und bietet Ihnen vielfältige Features. Managen Sie
in unserer Video Management Plattform Medien aller Art und profitieren Sie von unserer umfangreichen
Playerlösung.

### E-Learning und Wissensvermittlung

VIMP kann auch für die Wissensvermittlung und -abfrage eingesetzt werden. Sei es mit der VIMP
E-Learning Erweiterung oder durch die Anbindung an Ihr LMS wie Moodle oder Ilias.

### Full Managed Hosting oder On-premises

Installieren Sie VIMP auf Ihrem eigenen Videoserver oder lassen Sie uns das Hosting für Sie
übernehmen.

### Nahtlose Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften

Anbindung an AD über LDAP, SSO über SAML, Applikationsintegration über API, Layoutanpassung an
Corporate Design – alles ist möglich mit VIMP.

### Aktuelle Sicherheitsstandards und DSGVO-Konformität

VIMP beinhaltet alle Sicherheitsmechanismen, um Ihre Nutzer und Medien optimal zu schützen. Zudem
ist VIMP für den [DSGVO-konformen][29] Betrieb ausgelegt.
